The match gate: before and after

The referee's view. Each candidate brain plays 40 full jittered matches in match.py (the engine the game mirrors, eye-contact servo on) against the other athlete's current brain. A gate passes when no match blows up, the athlete lands at least 85 % of its strikes, self-falls on at most 6 % of them and its KO rate per landed strike is inside the L4 band.
